description: This file defines various trigger classes and objects used in Spark Structured Streaming for controlling streaming query execution timing, including processing time, continuous, real-time, and one-time triggers.

classes.name: ProcessingTimeTrigger
classes.description: A trigger that runs periodically based on processing time, with a specified interval in milliseconds.

classes.name: ContinuousTrigger
classes.description: A trigger that processes streaming data continuously, asynchronously checkpointing at a specified interval.

classes.name: RealTimeTrigger
classes.description: A trigger for real-time mode processing with a specified batch duration.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the trigger interval in milliseconds is non-negative.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts interval string, Duration, or Long with TimeUnit to milliseconds.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Factory methods to create trigger instances from string, Duration, or Long with TimeUnit.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Alias methods for creating trigger instances.
